data.Table Header: Recommendation Table 9 — Recommendations for non-invasive tests in the initial diagnostic management of individuals with suspected chronic coronary syndrome—stress echocardiography, if available, and supported by local expertise (see also Evidence Table 9)
data.Recommendations: In individuals with suspected CCS and moderate or high (>15%–85%) pre-test likelihood of obstructive CAD, stress echocardiography is recommended to diagnose myocardial ischaemia and to estimate the risk of MACE.33,241–246 I B
